'''Paul Merrian Space Warfare Deck''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Paul Merrian]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-9889">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9889 Space Warfare Deck], DeckTech (Paul "Ultima 1" Merrian, 26 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9889/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9889/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018130730/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9889/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Merrian]]
* '''Published:''' 26 August 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Space Warfare Deck''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 KD Merrian DS 2000 9889.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck is based off space superiority with some pilots that can battle on ground if necesary.

== Original post ==

'''Space Warfare Deck'''
* '''Author:''' Paul "Ultima 1" Merrian
* '''Published:''' August 26, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 2.5
* '''Description:''' This deck is based off space superiority with some pilots that can battle on ground if necesary.

=== Strategy ===

This deck is based around space battles.  The Star Destroyers provide powerful attacks.  Boba Fett, Ponda Baba and Dr. Evazian can be powerful on ground too, helping if an opponent is playing a ground deck.  Kessel makes all ships deploy -1, and getting Admiral Piett out early can help in that regard too.	The Victories should help if you have to go into ground battles.  With the large amount of starships, space draining is a secondary plan, but slower than battling.
